Hi Daniel,

Thanks for your note.

Regarding PO 6792: I can confirm the delivery date is 2026-11-12. The order is currently in transit.

On the customer list request: I'm not able to share our customer list or contact details. That information is confidential to our customers, and we don't disclose it to suppliers or other third parties. If you need specific delivery points pre-registered, please send us the particular locations you're expecting to serve and we can confirm those individually.

Best regards,
Marcus Castillo
Northwind Analytics
